title: Kc's Basic Innovations
description: A basic tech mod that adds new ways to process and use resources
body:
Kc's Basic Innovations adds new ores, alloys, and tools, as well as an overhaul of the smelting system.

**_This mod is a Work in Progress_**

If you encounter a bug, check the list of known issues before leaving a comment. Suggestions are always welcome!

# Features
## Current:
### New ores & metals
- Tin
- Zinc
- Lead
- Silver
- Graphite
- Ruby
- Bronze
- Brass
### New smelting methods
- Crucible
Alloy Smelter
### New Tools
- Bronze
### Other Changes
Fuel temperatures - high temperature required for better metals

## Planned:
### New Resources
- Steel
- Aluminium
### New Armour
- Bronze
- Lead
